description: This file implements the internal spinlock mechanism for the Abseil library, including lock acquisition, waiting, and profiling functionalities.

classes.name: SpinLock
classes.description: Internal implementation of a spinlock with profiling and scheduling features.

methods.name: RegisterSpinLockProfiler
methods.description: Registers a profiling callback for spinlock contention data.

methods.name: SpinLoop

methods.name: SlowUnlock
methods.description: Handles unlocking and profiling contention data.

methods.name: EncodeWaitCycles

methods.name: DecodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Decodes wait time from the lock word.
